source.caution:

- 질병이나 약물을 투여하시는 분은 의사와 상담 후 섭취하십시오. 
- 제품 개봉 또는 섭취 시 포장재에 의해 상처를 입을 수 있으니 주의하십시오.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 15mg Niacin, 130mg Milk thistle, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 8.5mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 15mg, 밀크씨슬 130mg, 비오틴 150μg, 비타민 B1 1.2mg, 비타민 B12 2.4μg, 비타민 B2 1.4mg, 비타민 B6 1.5mg, 아연 8.5mg, 엽산 400μg, 판토텐산 5mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 점박이를 포함한 흐린 황갈색의 투명 장방형 제피 정제 · 주식회사 노바렉스 제조

    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 밀크씨슬

  • 비오틴

    • 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B12

  • 비타민 B6
    • 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요

  • 판토텐산

Made by 주식회사 노바렉스 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 130mg of Milk thistle, 150μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 8.5mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 130mg Milk thistle, 150μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 8.5mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 노바렉스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Milk thistle labelled (130mg / 500mg), 80~120%
Biotin labelled (150μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 점박이를 포함한 흐린 황갈색의 투명 장방형 제피 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 1. 고온다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오. 3. 영유아 및 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Milk thistle · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
